entries.land_description: kitchen and bath facilities are available in this tropical country setting year round. An ideal place for workshops and groups wanting private space...combining work with the pleasure of nearby beaches and sailing. Organized trips are also available on and off the island.
entries.notes: We are/have: accessible, woods, camping space, women living on the land.

entries.land_description: Marigold's is a bed and breakfast guest house for women in our Victorian home in a suburb just west of Boston. We have three available guestrooms; one with private bath, two share a bath. Two cats live with us. There is no smoking in house or on grounds.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl children, boy children to age 10; nonlesbian women
entries.notes: Spanish and French spoken, some ASL.

entries.land_description: Aspasia is a small, homey guest house. We rent the upstairs of our home, which consists of three bedrooms and a shared bathroom. All of the rooms are comfortable, spacious and sunny, with double beds. The sun porch serves as a "common space" where women can gather to read or talk. During the summer months we serve continental breakfast. It is a short walk to the center of town and about two miles to the beach. Our rates are reasonable, and we offer a discount to groups of women who rent all three rooms.
entries.notes: NOTE: The area code for the next 5 listings in Provincetown is changing to 508 on July 15, 1988.

entries.land_description: Our three apartments have been newly renovated and are for sale to women investors. This is an ideal opportunity to invest in a women-only resort. Management of your rental property will be done on premises on a year-round basis.

Gabriel's is one of the older and more established guesthouses here. It's a place where women can enjoy a vacation with friends new or old. Our rooms and apartments are distinctive, individual, and immaculate. We're one block from the center of town and convenient to everything. Let's share a barbecue in the back yard or a long soothing soak in the hot tub. Take advantage of our common room with library, games, fireplace, and kitchen privileges.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl/boy children, nonlesbian women, males (off season only)
entries.notes: dogs in some units. We are/have: accessible.

entries.land_description: The Gull Walk Inn, established 1978, was the first all women guesthouse in Provincetown. It's conveniently located between Commercial St and Bradford St, behind the Terrace and May-flower restaurants, a half block from the Boston ferry and the bus stop. You can enjoy the common room with TV, stereo, and games. There are six rooms, two shared baths, microwave, refrigerator, deck with water view, front yard, front porch and more.

Plums Bed & Breakfast Inn is a woman-owned 1860 whaling captain's house with victorian decor, antiques, charm and comfort. It's like stepping back in time! All rooms with private bath, parking, full breakfast daily, common room, three blocks from town center. Open year round, two night minimum, four on holiday weekends. Cozy apartments also available.

entries.street_address: PO Box 188LC (located on Valley View Lane)
entries.land_description: The Highlands Inn is a year-round country inn in New Hampshire's beautiful White Mountains. We offer 19 charming guest rooms, spacious common areas, swimming pool, hot tub and miles of hiking/cross country ski trails on our 100-acre mountain setting.
entries.notes: We're all gay (99% women) all of the time except mid-week in fall; then we're 50-50 gay/straight. Our atmosphere is warm, friendly, peaceful and relaxing. We are/have: 101 acres, woods.

entries.street_address: Susan Roberts, PO Box 363, Tucson, AZ 85702 (located RR 1 Box 356, Readfield, ME 04355)
entries.land_description: The Red House is a 2-story, 3-bedroom house situated on five acres of woodland down a half-mile of privately owned dirt road in Central Maine. The house is 100 yards uphill from Torsey Pond, a 4 1/2 mile lake with access that is secluded enough for skinny-dipping. There is a completely equipped kitchen, and a stone fireplace provides heat. Work exchange May-June. Retreat or vacation house June-Sept.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl/boy children, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: dogs, cats, etc. We are/have: 5 acres, woods, not much camping space, women living on the land May-Sept, women working on the land May-June.

entries.land_description: Sea Gnome's Home is a Victorian house on the coast of Maine. Airy and comfortable rooms are available for women at daily, weekly or monthly rates. All residents share a large common bathroom, a kitchen, a parlor and an open back porch overlooking harbor and islands. Modest town restaurants serve fresh seafood, or you may cook up a lobster in the kitchen. Open June thru Sept.
